known_complex_fixture_math.input: x[n]=A*exp(rho*(n-n0))*cos(omega*(n-n0)+phi) for n>=n0, else0; n0=4096. Mathematical binary64 measurement fixture, not device synthesis.
known_complex_fixture_math.filter: h is the exact published firwin1455/Hamming/100Hz/scaletrue kernel, g=727; omega_c=2*pi*center/RATE; delta=omega-omega_c.
known_complex_fixture_math.positive_component: After transient, causal demodulated positive component is (A/2)*exp(rho*(n-n0))*exp(i*(delta*n-omega*n0+phi))*sum_j h[j]*exp(-(rho+i*delta)*j).
known_complex_fixture_math.expected_returned_amplitude: At group-delay-corrected time t=n0, the estimator returns A*exp(i*(phi-omega_c*n0))*G, with G=exp((rho+i*delta)*g)*sum_j h[j]*exp(-(rho+i*delta)*j). This includes real-cosine factor2, FIR response, global-demod phase and group-delay correction. It is NOT raw A*exp(i*phi).

single_control.checks: Published frequency/logradius/complexratio<=.005; original tighter frequency<1e-4Hz and logradius<1e-8 sanity checks remain. Nonzero detuning makes group-delay phase observable.

two_component_control.checks: Both known component modes must satisfy the unchanged published frequency/radius/complex amplitude limits. Compute and expose conjugate/crosscomponent relative complex leakage bound over all fit times, require it below existing.005 amplitude limit. Then exact whole compare(mixture,target-only,target-metric) must reject BOTH early-RMS waveforms, retaining every returned mode check. This deliberately distinguishes target-mode recovery from whole-signal equality.

known_complex_fixture_math.leakage_bound: For each undesired positive/negative component, add (Aj/At)*abs(Gj/Gt)*max_endpoint exp((rho_j-rho_t)*(n-g-n0)); endpoints cover5551..16383. Negative-frequency images use negativeomega and same rho. This bounds demodulated residual, not estimator uncertainty or actual capture error.
known_complex_fixture_math.wrong_convention_controls: Using the actual single fit, factor2, omitted globalcarrierphase and omitted exp((rho+i*delta)*g) expectations must each violate unchanged.005 complexratio limit. These are synthetic negative conventions, not new capture thresholds.
known_complex_fixture_math.half_diagnostics: Now retain full complex amplitude ratio, abs(ratio-1) and phase difference as descriptive values, without any half-window threshold.
